title: Crystal structure optimization
action: Build periodic unit cells from the CIF files of polymorphs (I) and (II). Assign Dreiding 2.21 force field atom types and charges using the charge equilibration (QEq) method. Perform cell-only minimization allowing the lattice parameters a, b, c, and beta to vary while constraining alpha=gamma=90 degrees and treating molecules as rigid. Record the optimized unit cell parameters for both polymorphs.
description: Required intermediate step that produces the optimized crystal geometries used in the energy calculation.

title: Calculate lattice energies and energy differences
action: For the original crystallographic structures (from CIF) and the optimized structures from step_01, compute the total lattice energy (potential energy per unit cell) using the Dreiding 2.21 force field with QEq charges under periodic boundary conditions. Compute delta_cryst = E(II)_cryst - E(I)_cryst and delta_opt = E(II)_opt - E(I)_opt. Write all values to energies.json.
description: JSON file containing the four total lattice energies and the two energy differences.
output_schema: Keys: energy_I_cryst (float), energy_II_cryst (float), energy_I_opt (float), energy_II_opt (float), delta_cryst (float), delta_opt (float). All in kcal/mol.
